args.cover_letter:
AUC 0.87; retention team saved an estimated $310k ARR in two quarters: that was the outcome of my subscription churn prediction project, which is close to what you describe.

For Data Analysis: in the fine-tuned clinical note summariser project I loRA fine-tuned an open 8B model on de-identified notes on SageMaker, with a clinician review loop. For Python: in the payment fraud detection with graph neural networks project I modelled accounts, devices and cards as a graph in Neo4j and trained a GraphSAGE classifier.

I have not used React Native in client work, so I would start with a short spike and confirm the approach with you before building on it.

Plan: a short discovery call, a first working milestone you can test, then documentation and a handover call.

Is the Data Analysis part already started, or would this be built from scratch?
answers: My fine-tuned clinical note summariser project: Draft summaries accepted with light edits 78% of the time; ROUGE-L +9 over the base model. The case study and code are in my marketplace portfolio and I can walk you through them on a call.
Access to the current code or data, one sample of the expected output, and a 30-minute kickoff to agree the first milestone.
